title: Measuring Time: Pendulums and Clocks
summary: From sundials and ghatis to pendulum clocks and atomic clocks: how periodic motion keeps time.

ib.note: Classic MYP Criterion B/C fair-test investigation

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 8: Measurement of Time and Motion (simple pendulum, time period)
Curiosity Ch 11: Keeping Time with the Skies

objectives: I can describe how people measured time using periodic events (the Sun, the Moon, water clocks).
I can define oscillation and time period for a simple pendulum.
I can plan and carry out a fair test to find what affects a pendulum's time period.
I can explain why timing many oscillations gives a more accurate result.
misconceptions: Timing one swing is as good as timing ten.
